programs.title: Sleeping With My Student
programs.desc: New school headmaster Kathy discovers her vacation fling with charming 18-year-old Ian was no accident when he transfers to her school and targets Kathy and her teenage daughter Bree in a deadly scheme.

programs.title: Family Vanished
programs.desc: Family members return from vacation and discover that criminals have taken over their home and identities. They are held hostage and forced to drain a business account, and when they escape, they are named as suspects in the thefts.

programs.title: Secrets in the Woods
programs.desc: A woman discovers a horrifying secret about her boyfriend's father during a romantic getaway in the woods.

programs.title: Temptation Under the Sun
programs.desc: While vacationing on an exotic island, Detective Cassady Cruz begins a torrid affair with an expat named Travis. However, when he becomes the main suspect in the death of his ex-girlfriend, Cassady tries to clear his name by finding the real killer.

programs.title: Danger Below Deck
programs.desc: Two influencers find themselves on a luxury cruise through the Caribbean and South Pacific, but a battle of wills threatens to tear them apart as the mirage of their online personas begins to clash with their real-life ambitions.

programs.title: Cabin Pressure
programs.desc: A flight attendant gets a mysterious call from a stranger who tries to blackmail her into poisoning a passenger in exchange for her family. One way or another, someone will die during the flight as the plane gets closer to its destination.
